BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MANISH CHOUDHURY  ORDER Date : 18.12.2023 Heard Mr. S. Bikash, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. S. Baruah, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 1, 2 & 6.
2.
It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner has been maintaining a savings bank account at the Dispur Branch of the respondent State Bank of India.

The primary grievance of the petitioner is that during the period from 04.06.2022 to 20.06.2022, certain unauthorized transactions took place in the said account and a total amount of Rs. 3,71,295/- was shown to be withdrawn through such unauthorised transactions.
The petitioner has asserted that the Page No.# 3/4 said amount had been withdrawn by unknown miscreants through fraudulent unauthorized transactions.

2.1. The petitioner has made a categorical assertion that she is maintaining the savings bank account bearing no. 33082806872 at the Dispur Branch of the respondent State Bank of India [respondent no. 5].

In connection with the said account, a 16 digit ATC-cum-Debit Card linked with the said bank account was also issued to the petitioner by the respondent no. 5 but the petitioner never used the Kamana Dev Barma vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7556654/
2 said ATM-cum-Debit card for the purpose of any e-commerce and did not link the said ATM-cum-Debit Card or bank account to any UPI based payment application or app.

sentences.text: The petitioner has also asserted that the petitioner did not create any 3D password for making online transaction from the said savings bank account.

2.2. Highlighting the alleged fraudulent and unauthorized transactions in respect of the said bank account, the petitioner had lodged a First Information Report [FIR] before the Officer-In-Charge,
Dispur Police Station [respondent no. 6] and the said FIR has been registered as Dispur Police Station Case no. 1756/2022 for the offence under Section 420, Indian Penal Code.
The investigation in connection with Dispur Police Station Case no. 1756/2022 is stated to be pending as on date.
The petitioner has also complained about continuance of the investigation in a lackadaisical manner.

2.3. Prima facie such kind of allegations are matters of investigation by investigating authority and are about deficiency in service by the respondent bank, but in view of the categorical assertions made by the petitioner, as extracted in paragraph 2.1 above, the Court is inclined to issue notice to the respondents.
Page No.# 4/4 3.
Issue notice, returnable on 02.02.2024.
4. As Mr. Baruah, learned Junior Government Advocate has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 1, 2 & 6, no formal notices need to be issued to the said respondents.

Mr.
Bikash, learned counsel for the petitioners shall, however, furnish requisite nos. of extra copies of the writ petition along with annexures, to Mr. Baruah within 2 [two] working days from today.
5. The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 3, 4 & 5 by registered post with A/D within 2 [two] working days from today.
6. Mr. Baruah,learned Junior Government Advocate shall obtain a status report in respect of Dispur Police Station Case no. 1756/2022 on the next date of listing.
